Service notes · Xylo Solutions

Ecommerce Marketing and Your Storefront: Making the Journey Consistent

Connect the promise of a campaign with the product experience customers see after they click.

Start with the audience

Xylo Solutions positions ecommerce marketing around attracting relevant visitors and supporting growth. The audience and the reason they visit should inform what the storefront communicates.

Keep the message consistent

A campaign and its destination page should tell the same story. Product benefits, photography and the next action need to make sense together.

Review the whole journey

Traffic, design and development are connected. Consider the steps from arrival to product discovery and checkout when deciding where to improve the experience.
